infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Kruto Tastes uses your location to verify you are at the assigned store before clocking in.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Kruto Tastes uses your location continuously in the background to enforce geofence rules while you are clocked in to a shift.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Kruto Tastes needs your location in the background to automatically manage break times when you leave or return to your assigned store.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Kruto Tastes uses your camera to take photos of receipts for shift recaps.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Kruto Tastes accesses your photo library to attach receipt images to shift recaps.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Kruto Tastes saves receipt photos to your photo library.
